source.candidate_scope: Complete rendering patch: sparse depth, label rejection, terrain texture retention, selection stream reuse, culling and pixel-window filtering. CPU workload excludes GL submission/presentation; no isolated attribution.

scope: Untimed cache/identity probe: 80 frames, 16-view repeated loop, four Manhattan cameras. Frame allocation is diagnostic; final formal native benchmark is authoritative. Baseline probe used default tiering and candidate probe disabled tiering. Integrated candidate includes selection/label/depth changes, so total allocation changes are not attributed solely to the cache.

cache_budget.accounting: SKBitmap.RowBytes*Height plus immutable uint texel array length*4. Budget covers renderer-owned retained cache; caller-held frame snapshots and transient bake buffers are excluded.

sequence_dictionary_encoding: CSV sequence SHA256 is SHA256(UTF-8 JSON.stringify(array)); dictionary preserves exact original array order. Shared arrays are stored once to avoid duplicate snapshots.
